configurations.comment:
node, not pnpm: the pnpm shim is not on PATH for every spawner here, and .bin shims hang under Git Bash. cwd must be apps/web — Prisma resolves its query engine relative to the working directory, and running next from the repo root with the app as an argument makes it search D:
ode_modules and fail at request time, not at startup.
